hypothesis: A pre-registered hypothesis under test, not an edge claim. Closing-auction imbalances push the 16:00 ET cash print away from fair value and the deviation partly reverts soon after the close (Bogousslavsky-Muravyev, JFM 2023, US stocks); ES keeps trading to 16:15 ET, so the index-level 15:50->16:00 move should partly revert 16:01->16:07. Sign fixed: FADE the 15:50->16:00 ES move. Source candidates.md rank 55 (AF C-1-08).
rules: Data: Databento GLBX.MDP3 ohlcv-1m, stype_in=continuous, <ROOT>.v.0, bought 2026-11-09 by batch job AFTER this registration (estimate row first); ingested to DATA_ROOT/derived/<dataset>.parquet, ts = bar OPEN in UTC, columns open/high/low/close/volume/instrument_id; rows >= 2025-01-01 only to DATA_ROOT/holdout/. Times are America/New_York via zoneinfo. P(HH:MM) = CLOSE of the bar opening HH:MM-1min (last trade before HH:MM:00); if that bar is missing, the latest earlier bar within 5 minutes with the same instrument_id, else the observation is ineligible (counted). Any return uses two prices with the same instrument_id (roll rule ex ante). Trading days = full XNYS sessions (exchange_calendars), early closes skipped. EWMA sigma = sqrt(EWMA, centre of mass 60, of the squared signal over the instrument's prior eligible days through d-1), at least 40 prior observations (IS warm-up read first). Signal m(d) = ln(P(16:00)/P(15:50)) on ES. Trade on d iff |m| > 1.0 x EWMA sigma of m. Position = -sign(m), one ES contract. ENTRY at the OPEN of the bar opening 16:01 ET; EXIT at the CLOSE of the bar opening 16:06 ET (last trade before 16:07:00, inside Topstep's 16:08 auto-flatten). Per-event net return (bp of entry notional) = sign x ln(exit/entry) - costs. No stops or targets.
parameters: window 15:50->16:00; threshold 1.0 sigma; entry 16:01 open; exit 16:06 close (6 min); neighbours (fixed now): threshold 0.75 and 1.25 sigma; exit at the CLOSE of the 16:04 bar and of the 16:07 bar (hold 4 / 7 min); EWMA com 45 and 75; one-bar-delay = entry at the OPEN of the 16:02 bar; volatility terciles = ES trailing 20-day s.d. of 16:00-to-16:00 log returns (IS bounds). Information only: longs-after-down-moves subset; sub-periods 2015-2017, 2018-2021, 2022-2024.
instruments: CME ES front (MES for sizing, same prices)
vol_scaler: none: one ES contract per event; the series is per-event net bp of notional
cost_model: per side ES 0.50 pt x $50 + $2.50 (post-16:00 book is thinner than the RTH floor 0.30 pt; fixed now), at entry and exit, in bp of entry notional; 2x run doubles every per-side cost.
notes: Evidence window: US stocks ~2010-2019; ES 16:00-16:07 never measured in any source seen, so OOS 2015-2024 is not a derivative window for ES. Closed relatives: H0006/H0019 (15:30-16:00 momentum, opposite window and sign), H0012/H0017 (09:30 gap fade) different. Prior low (index imbalances net out; 1-2 bp gross as likely as 3-5 bp). Power at OOS 10 y, ~100 events/yr: criterion-4 power ~0.86 at true Sharpe 1.5.
owner: Director (main session 2026-11-09, D-028); Pre-registration Officer: Director
data_sha256: PINNED AT INGEST (data bought after this registration): sha256 of each derived parquet written to data/manifest.csv before the first gateway read; the result file prints manifest = recomputed
decision_rule: Gate v2 on the OOS window only, exactly one read through qe.gateway.load(id,'oos') per dataset in one run (IS read for warm-up first): pass iff (1) the deciding one-sided t (minimum of iid, Newey-West lag 10 and the ET-date-clustered t of the net-1x per-event series) >= 3.6807 AND the stationary-bootstrap (>= 430,000 draws) one-sided lower bound at alpha 0.05/430 > 0; (2) net-2x mean > 0; (3) PARAMETERS.md criteria 4 and 7: >= 70% of OOS calendar years positive, no single year > 50% of a positive net, >= 2 of 3 IS-bounded volatility terciles positive, every +-25% neighbour in parameters net-positive, the one-bar-delay variant net-positive; (4) Red Team / re-implementation sign-off; (5) hold-out read in the restated one-sided tolerance form with h = decay_haircut. Mechanical verdict: PASS Gate 3 if (1)-(3); NEAR-MISS if deciding t >= 2.6807 with bootstrap 5th percentile of the mean > 0; else FAIL. Before the OOS read, on IS only: truncation harness (delete every bar after the entry instant; decision unchanged), perturbation harness (1% noise on post-entry bars) on >= 30 sampled IS events, and a planted look-ahead must fail. The result file prints criterion-4 power and the joint figure for its own OOS length.
